{%- comment -%}
  llms.txt — a plain-text map of the site for language models.

  What this is and is not: llms.txt is a proposed convention, not a standard
  anyone has committed to consuming. No major model provider has said it is a
  retrieval or ranking signal. It is here because it costs nothing, cannot
  hurt, and is generated rather than maintained — the structured data in
  _includes/structured-data.html is what is actually read today.

  Generated from _config.yml and _data, so adding a ride or a video updates
  this file on the next build. Nothing below is typed by hand twice.

  `layout: null` keeps the HTML chrome off it and `permalink` puts it at the
  root, where the convention expects it. `sitemap: false` keeps it out of
  sitemap.xml — it is a machine aid, not a page to index.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- capture strava_url %}{% include strava-url.html %}{% endcapture -%}
# DaPenguin — Anthony Brown

> Anthony Brown, who rides as DaPenguin, is a Marine veteran and cyclist based
> in Caldwell County, Kentucky. He is in his {% include kcc-year.html years=site.kcc.years_completed case="lower" %} consecutive year completing the
> Kentucky Cycling Challenge, an annual series of {{ site.kcc.rides_in_series }} rides each requiring a
> century or metric century. This site records his training, the events he
> rides, his cycling travel, and photographs and video from the bike.

Mileage figures on the site are pulled from Strava automatically and are
current as of the last build. Ride distances and elevations shown on the Rides
page are logged activity data, not estimates.

## Notes for machine readers

- Every page carries schema.org JSON-LD. Person and WebSite nodes appear
  throughout; pages use WebPage, ProfilePage or CollectionPage as appropriate.
  The Rides page adds upcoming SportsEvent entries, and Photos & Video adds a
  VideoObject per clip.
- The two Cycle Jamaica clips were filmed and released by Cycle Caribbean
  (formerly Cycle Jamaica), not by Anthony, and are published here with
  permission. Their VideoObject entries credit that organisation, not him.
- The site is built by Bluedobie Developing. That is a build credit, not a
  sponsorship.
